title: Mario Is Missing!
shortDescription: Mario Is Missing! helps define a Super Nintendo Entertainment System educational path in GameAtlas through a frozen catalog method and a direct Wikidata record.
highlights: Sets a direct-reference educational marker within the Super Nintendo Entertainment System catalog.
Uses a factual reference path instead of an aggregate score or review.

signals.label: GameAtlas catalog method
signals.rationale: Cataloged for the Super Nintendo Entertainment System educational discovery path using the frozen source metadata record; this remains a source-aware catalog entry, not a review or rating.
